reason: The skill has a concrete first user path through AI affiliate creators who already use Claude/Higgsfield/OpenClaw workflows, but monetization should wait until real campaign receipts and usage are visible.
first_traffic_source_plan: GitHub release and ClawHub listing under zack-dev-cm
Short demo showing a low-risk creator desk gear campaign ledger passing QC
Cross-link from agentic-video-production-publisher docs and future Chrome extension landing page
trust_reason: Open-source skill with deterministic validation scripts
Current FTC, Amazon, Pinterest, TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube compliance references
Avoids copied paid prompt-pack text and blocks weak disclosures

share_trigger.user_feels: relief that their affiliate post has receipts before publishing
share_trigger.user_has: a campaign JSON, QC report, and OpenClaw handoff they can show or reuse
share_trigger.user_shares_with: another AI creator or automation operator
share_trigger.user_says: This catches affiliate disclosure and claim risks before I burn a post.
share_trigger.user_gains: fewer platform/account surprises and faster repeat campaign setup

free_mvp.first_10_users: AI video creators, affiliate experimenters, and OpenClaw/Codex users already asking for publishing workflows
free_mvp.giveaway: free skill, sample low-risk campaign ledger, and Claude upload zip
free_mvp.onboarding_prompt: Paste a product URL, affiliate program, target platforms, and whether you personally used the product; the skill creates and validates a campaign ledger.

day_7.target: 3 installs or users run the sample campaign checker

day_30.target: 10 installs, 3 real campaign ledgers, or 1 request for extension/setup help
day_30.shutdown_threshold: fewer than 3 installs and no campaign examples

day_60.target: 20 installs or 3 users asking for paid templates/setup
day_60.shutdown_threshold: no repeat use and no request for receipt extension

top_risks: Creators may prefer raw viral prompt packs over compliance tooling.
Sensitive niches like supplements create support burden and policy ambiguity.
Without a Chrome receipt extension, updating campaign ledgers still takes discipline.
next_experiment: Publish v0.1.1, record one low-risk demo campaign, and measure whether users ask for the receipt extension.
